retained_findings.details: The first escaping test replaced equations referenced by other fixture pages. It was corrected to append the escaped content; validation was not weakened.

An isolated unprotected-parser probe reproduces loss of an existing outer link when a nested citation is recognized. The protected-range parse preserves existing link/image labels; integration regressions pass.
The initial resolver bypass applied outside books. It is now restricted to book citations validated by the parser; ordinary non-book private-scheme links fail validation.
The final guide clarifies that PDF URL-query rejection applies to internal links. External HTTP(S) links may carry queries; the bibliography fixture and strict/deep docs cover the distinction.
The separate WebKit overflow and documentation hydration findings remain open; later feature acceptance does not close them.

limits: Public rc.6 and production hosting are unchanged.
Generic numeric formatting with documented CSL-JSON fields; no claim of complete CSL support or APA/Chicago compliance.
BibTeX, custom CSL styles, author-date/note styles and author-in-text syntax remain separate work.
Index/glossary, multilingual print, Next-image PDFs and richer book editions remain open.
Live provider verification and production-domain migration remain deferred.
No claim of zero bugs or completed 1.0.
